articles.title: (W.E. Talk) The ocean as a bridge: how China advances global ocean governance
articles.titleCn: （东西问）海洋作为桥梁：中国如何推动全球海洋治理
articles.summary: The ocean belongs to all humanity as our shared home, and constitutes a key arena for global governance. Since its adoption, the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) has played a pivotal role in enabling humanity to better understand, protect and utilize the ocean.
articles.summaryCn: 中国作为联合国海洋法公约缔约国，积极参与全球海洋治理，推动海洋可持续发展，并倡导构建海洋命运共同体。

paragraphs.en: (CNS)-- The ocean belongs to all humanity as our shared home, and constitutes a key {{0}} for global governance. Since its adoption, the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) has played a {{1}} role in enabling humanity to better understand, protect and utilize the ocean. As the international maritime order undergoes {{2}} readjustment, it has become a common concern of all countries how to advance marine sustainable development and strengthen global ocean governance. 2026 marks the 30th anniversary of China's status as a State Party to UNCLOS. As a major maritime developing country, China stands ready to work with all other countries to forge a new journey in ocean governance with the bridge of the ocean.
paragraphs.cn: 海洋是全人类共同的家园，也是全球治理的关键领域。自通过以来，《联合国海洋法公约》在帮助人类更好地认识、保护和利用海洋方面发挥了关键作用。随着国际海洋秩序深刻调整，如何推进海洋可持续发展、加强全球海洋治理已成为各国共同关切。2026年是中国成为《公约》缔约国30周年。作为一个海洋大国和发展中国家，中国愿与各国一道，以海洋为桥梁，开启海洋治理的新征程。

paragraphs.en: As one of the original {{3}}, China has consistently ensured the full and faithful {{4}} of UNCLOS provisions, standing as an active participant, builder, and contributor to UNCLOS and its mechanisms. Historically, the Third United Nations Conference on the Law of the Sea marked the first important international legislative process in which China participated following the restoration of its lawful seat in the United Nations. Taking into account the interests of itself, developing countries, and the international community as a whole, China actively promoted the establishment of a just and {{5}} international maritime order. Standing side by side with numerous developing countries, China jointly advocated for the reaffirmation of vital principles and systems of the law of the sea, such as 'the common {{6}} of mankind', thereby making a significant contribution to the adoption of UNCLOS. Since becoming a State Party, China has adhered to the spirit of UNCLOS, implemented its provisions fully and faithfully, and promoted the full implementation of UNCLOS in domestic maritime legislation, law enforcement, and judicial practice.
paragraphs.cn: 作为最初的签署国之一，中国始终坚持全面、忠实地履行《公约》条款，是《公约》及其机制的积极参与者、建设者和贡献者。历史上，第三次联合国海洋法会议是中国恢复联合国合法席位后参与的第一个重要国际立法进程。中国兼顾自身、发展中国家和国际社会的整体利益，积极推动建立公正合理的国际海洋秩序。中国与众多发展中国家并肩，共同倡导重申'人类共同继承财产'等海洋法的重要原则和制度，为《公约》的通过作出了重要贡献。成为缔约国以来，中国恪守《公约》精神，全面、忠实地履行其条款，并在国内海洋立法、执法和司法实践中推动《公约》的全面实施。

paragraphs.en: China takes an active and in-depth part in developing the global ocean governance system, and continuously supports and facilitates the effective functioning of the three important institutions established under UNCLOS: the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (ITLOS), the International Seabed Authority (ISA), and the Commission on the Limits of the Continental Shelf (CLCS). China keeps advancing the development of a modern maritime order and actively participates in negotiations on UNCLOS implementing agreements, such as the Agreement Relating to the Implementation of Part XI of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea of 10 December 1982 (1994 Implementation Agreement) and the Agreement for the Implementation of the Provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea of 10 December 1982 Relating to the Conservation and Management of Straddling Fish Stocks and Highly Migratory Fish Stocks (UN Fish Stocks Agreement). The Agreement under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity of Areas beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ Agreement) represents an outcome of 19 years of negotiations. China took part in the relevant process throughout and actively pushed for the entry-into-force of the BBNJ Agreement this January, and supports Xiamen's application to host the Secretariat of the BBNJ Agreement, thereby demonstrating its sense of responsibility as a major country. In addition, China has engaged constructively in significant international rule-making processes, such as consultations on regulations for the {{9}} of deep-sea mineral resources.
paragraphs.cn: 中国积极深入参与全球海洋治理体系的建设，持续支持并促进《公约》设立的三大重要机构——国际海洋法法庭、国际海底管理局和大陆架界限委员会的有效运作。中国不断推进现代海洋秩序的发展，积极参与《公约》执行协定的谈判，例如《关于执行1982年12月10日〈联合国海洋法公约〉第十一部分的协定》和《执行1982年12月10日〈联合国海洋法公约〉有关养护和管理跨界鱼类种群和高度洄游鱼类种群的规定的协定》。《国家管辖范围以外区域海洋生物多样性的养护和可持续利用协定》是19年谈判的成果。中国全程参与了相关进程，并于今年1月积极推动该协定生效，支持厦门申请作为该协定秘书处所在地，展现了大国担当。此外，中国还建设性地参与了深海矿产资源开发规章磋商等重要国际规则制定进程。

paragraphs.en: The ocean constitutes a treasure trove of resources and a {{10}} space underpinning future development. China has consistently integrated its own development into the global sustainable development framework, expanded blue partnerships, engaged deeply in global ocean governance, and actively advanced the building of a maritime community with a shared future. Over the years, China has taken proactive measures to safeguard freedom of navigation and navigational safety and keep international shipping lanes unimpeded. China respects and upholds the freedom of navigation and overflight to which all countries are entitled under international law, and firmly opposes acts that undermine the {{11}} and security of other countries under the pretext of so-called 'freedom of navigation'. Moreover, China continues to upgrade maritime support services such as maritime search and rescue, greatly boosting navigational safety.
paragraphs.cn: 海洋是资源宝库和支撑未来发展的战略空间。中国始终将自身发展融入全球可持续发展框架，拓展蓝色伙伴关系，深度参与全球海洋治理，积极推动构建海洋命运共同体。多年来，中国采取积极措施保障航行自由和航行安全，维护国际航道畅通。中国尊重和维护各国根据国际法享有的航行和飞越自由，坚决反对以所谓'航行自由'为名损害他国主权和安全的行为。此外，中国不断提升海上搜救等海上保障服务能力，极大地促进了航行安全。

paragraphs.en: The maritime public goods supplied by China deliver shared benefits to all stakeholders. The source codes for the Mazu series ocean current and wave {{12}} models have been open-sourced globally. The South China Sea Tsunami Advisory Centre (SCSTAC) is capable of releasing its initial advisory within 10 minutes, boasting world-leading speed and accuracy. China has long offered neighboring countries round-the-clock tsunami forecasting and warning services as well as personnel training. Its emergency remote sensing monitoring services for disasters have received favorable feedback from government authorities of Pacific island countries such as Kiribati and the Solomon Islands.
paragraphs.cn: 中国提供的海洋公共产品惠及所有利益攸关方。'妈祖'系列海流和海浪预报模型源代码已向全球开源。南海海啸预警中心能在10分钟内发布初始预警，速度和精度均居世界前列。中国长期为周边国家提供全天候的海啸预报预警服务和人员培训。其灾害应急遥感监测服务获得了基里巴斯、所罗门群岛等太平洋岛国政府部门的积极反馈。

paragraphs.en: By advancing digital and intelligent technological transformation, China deepens maritime cooperation and provides solid support for {{13}}-building in developing countries. Jointly with African countries, China has released and launched the Xinghai Multi-scale Comprehensive Marine Dataset. It includes an online marine remote sensing analysis platform, remote sensing monitoring of the coastal zones of Africa and the Indian Ocean, and AI-based integrated four-dimensional chlorophyll datasets. It has also developed the 'Toolkit for Marine Solutions for Sustainable Development of Coastal Cities' to deliver convenient marine information services and efficient decision-making support for integrated governance to developing countries. China advances practical maritime cooperation driven by 'small yet beautiful' projects.
paragraphs.cn: 通过推进数字化、智能化技术转型，中国深化海洋合作，为发展中国家能力建设提供坚实支撑。中国与非洲国家共同发布并启动了'星海'多尺度综合海洋数据集。该数据集包括在线海洋遥感分析平台、非洲和印度洋海岸带遥感监测以及基于人工智能的四维叶绿素综合数据集。中国还开发了'沿海城市可持续发展海洋解决方案工具包'，为发展中国家提供便捷的海洋信息服务和高效的综合治理决策支持。中国以'小而美'项目推动务实海洋合作。

paragraphs.en: Leveraging its extensive network and institutional platforms of blue partnerships, China and Madagascar jointly established a sea level change observation station to carry out long-term, continuous and high-precision sea level monitoring in the South Indian Ocean region. The station has been officially incorporated into the UNESCO Global Sea Level Observing System (GLOSS), contributing to climate change responses. China has also joined forces with relevant countries and international organizations to launch the Blue Citizens Initiative. Together with Thailand, Indonesia, Cambodia and other countries, China has delivered marine classroom and nature education programs, and jointly built Blue Communities, effectively raising ocean literacy within coastal communities. The ocean unites the world into a community where we all rise and fall together.
paragraphs.cn: 依托广泛的蓝色伙伴关系网络和机构平台，中国与马达加斯加共同建立了海平面变化观测站，在南印度洋区域开展长期、连续、高精度的海平面监测。该站已正式纳入联合国教科文组织全球海平面观测系统，为应对气候变化作出贡献。中国还联合相关国家和国际组织发起'蓝色公民'倡议。中国与泰国、印度尼西亚、柬埔寨等国共同开展海洋课堂和自然教育项目，共建蓝色社区，有效提升了沿海社区的海洋素养。海洋将世界联结成一个休戚与共的共同体。

paragraphs.en: To achieve the object of promoting 'the economic and social advancement of all peoples of the world', there is no reason for UNCLOS to remain stagnant and unchanging. Instead, it ought to embrace new wisdom, concepts, and approaches to ocean governance with a more open, inclusive and forward-looking stance. The international community needs to join hands to uphold {{16}} and international law, including UNCLOS. UNCLOS provides a comprehensive legal framework to safeguard the overall interests of the international community. Together with other maritime treaties and agreements, as well as customary international law, it underpins the modern system of the law of the sea.
paragraphs.cn: 为了实现促进'世界各国人民的经济和社会进步'的目标，《公约》没有理由停滞不前。相反，它应以更加开放、包容和前瞻的姿态，吸纳海洋治理的新智慧、新理念和新方法。国际社会需要携手维护多边主义和国际法，包括《公约》。《公约》为维护国际社会的整体利益提供了全面的法律框架。它与其它海洋条约、协定以及习惯国际法一道，构成了现代海洋法体系的基础。

paragraphs.en: Valuing this milestone achieved through joint efforts of the entire international community, China advocates squarely addressing the internal constraints and external challenges in the implementation of UNCLOS. For instance, UNCLOS contains inherent limitations. It cannot cover all matters of the law of the sea, and lacks sufficient institutional provisions to address newly emerging ocean affairs, which undermines its enforcement outcomes. Its implementation is simultaneously hindered by multiple obstacles, such as the misinterpretation of its provisions and the abuse of its procedures. Meanwhile, unilateral moves further erode the legal order founded under UNCLOS and damage its solemnity and authority.
paragraphs.cn: 珍视这一国际社会共同努力取得的里程碑，中国主张正视《公约》实施中的内在制约和外部挑战。例如，《公约》存在固有局限性。它无法涵盖所有海洋法事项，且缺乏足够的制度规定来应对新出现的海洋事务，这削弱了其执行效果。其执行同时受到多种障碍的阻碍，例如对其条款的曲解和对其程序的滥用。同时，单边行动进一步侵蚀了《公约》所确立的法律秩序，损害了其严肃性和权威性。

paragraphs.en: It demonstrates due respect for its negotiating history and spirit of compromise to view UNCLOS in an objective, holistic and dialectical manner. It is essential to calibrate its positioning within the modern legal order for the seas and oceans-without underestimating or overstating its value-so as to properly balance continuity and development in the law of the sea. It represents the right approach to uphold UNCLOS by interpreting and applying it fully, accurately, and in good faith. Rights conferred by UNCLOS should be exercised in a reasonable manner, and obligations thereunder discharged in good faith. The object and purpose of UNCLOS must be safeguarded, its built-in balance preserved, and abusive practices-such as interpretive distortions, abuse of process, and {{18}} overreach-opposed.
paragraphs.cn: 客观、全面、辩证地看待《公约》，是对其谈判历史和妥协精神的应有尊重。必须校准其在现代海洋法律秩序中的定位——既不低估也不夸大其价值——从而妥善平衡海洋法的延续与发展。全面、准确、善意地解释和适用《公约》，是维护《公约》的正确途径。《公约》赋予的权利应合理行使，其项下的义务应善意履行。必须维护《公约》的目标和宗旨，保持其内在平衡，反对解释扭曲、程序滥用和管辖权过度扩张等滥用行为。

paragraphs.en: It provides viable solutions to address persistent difficulties and challenges in UNCLOS implementation and improve global ocean governance by jointly advancing China's Four Global Initiatives. In the pursuit of the Sustainable Development Goals, modern law of the sea and China's cultural ethos can {{19}} in values. The path forward lies in practicing true multilateralism, accelerating the delivery of tangible outcomes under these Initiatives, and fostering a more just and equitable system for global ocean governance so as to advance steadily toward a community with a shared future for mankind. Against the accelerating once-in-a-century global transformation, the ocean should serve as a vital platform to build consensus and pursue shared development. All countries need to regard win-win cooperation as a priority, jointly sustain and deepen solidarity in maritime cooperation and governance, and devote greater wisdom and strength to building our shared blue homeland.
paragraphs.cn: 通过共同推进中国的'四大全球倡议'，可以为解决《公约》实施中持续存在的困难和挑战、改善全球海洋治理提供可行方案。在追求可持续发展目标的过程中，现代海洋法与中国文化精神可以产生价值共鸣。前进的道路在于践行真正的多边主义，加快落实这些倡议下的切实成果，并建立一个更加公正合理的全球海洋治理体系，从而稳步迈向人类命运共同体。在百年未有之大变局加速演进的背景下，海洋应成为凝聚共识、谋求共同发展的重要平台。各国需以合作共赢为重，共同维护和深化海洋合作与治理中的团结，为建设我们共同的蓝色家园贡献更多智慧和力量。

paragraphs.en: The author, Shu Zhenya, is a research fellow of the China Institute for Marine Affairs, Ministry of Natural Resources of China.
paragraphs.cn: 作者舒振亚，系自然资源部海洋发展战略研究所研究员。

(CNS)-- The ocean belongs to all humanity as our shared home, and constitutes a key arena for global governance. Since its adoption, the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) has played a pivotal role in enabling humanity to better understand, protect and utilize the ocean.
As the international maritime order undergoes profound readjustment, it has become a common concern of all countries how to advance marine sustainable development and strengthen global ocean governance. 2026 marks the 30th anniversary of China's status as a State Party to UNCLOS. As a major maritime developing country, China stands ready to work with all other countries to forge a new journey in ocean governance with the bridge of the ocean.
As one of the original signatories, China has consistently ensured the full and faithful implementation of UNCLOS provisions, standing as an active participant, builder, and contributor to UNCLOS and its mechanisms.
Historically, the Third United Nations Conference on the Law of the Sea marked the first important international legislative process in which China participated following the restoration of its lawful seat in the United Nations. Taking into account the interests of itself, developing countries, and the international community as a whole, China actively promoted the establishment of a just and equitable international maritime order. Standing side by side with numerous developing countries, China jointly advocated for the reaffirmation of vital principles and systems of the law of the sea, such as 'the common heritage of mankind', thereby making a significant contribution to the adoption of UNCLOS.
Since becoming a State Party, China has adhered to the spirit of UNCLOS, implemented its provisions fully and faithfully, and promoted the full implementation of UNCLOS in domestic maritime legislation, law enforcement, and judicial practice.
China takes an active and in-depth part in developing the global ocean governance system, and continuously supports and facilitates the effective functioning of the three important institutions established under UNCLOS: the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (ITLOS), the International Seabed Authority (ISA), and the Commission on the Limits of the Continental Shelf (CLCS).
China keeps advancing the development of a modern maritime order and actively participates in negotiations on UNCLOS implementing agreements, such as the Agreement Relating to the Implementation of Part XI of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea of 10 December 1982 (1994 Implementation Agreement) and the Agreement for the Implementation of the Provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea of 10 December 1982 Relating to the Conservation and Management of Straddling Fish Stocks and Highly Migratory Fish Stocks (UN Fish Stocks Agreement). The Agreement under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity of Areas beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ Agreement) represents an outcome of 19 years of negotiations. China took part in the relevant process throughout and actively pushed for the entry-into-force of the BBNJ Agreement this January, and supports Xiamen's application to host the Secretariat of the BBNJ Agreement, thereby demonstrating its sense of responsibility as a major country. In addition, China has engaged constructively in significant international rule-making processes, such as consultations on regulations for the exploitation of deep-sea mineral resources.
The ocean constitutes a treasure trove of resources and a strategic space underpinning future development. China has consistently integrated its own development into the global sustainable development framework, expanded blue partnerships, engaged deeply in global ocean governance, and actively advanced the building of a maritime community with a shared future.
Over the years, China has taken proactive measures to safeguard freedom of navigation and navigational safety and keep international shipping lanes unimpeded. China respects and upholds the freedom of navigation and overflight to which all countries are entitled under international law, and firmly opposes acts that undermine the sovereignty and security of other countries under the pretext of so-called 'freedom of navigation'. Moreover, China continues to upgrade maritime support services such as maritime search and rescue, greatly boosting navigational safety.
The maritime public goods supplied by China deliver shared benefits to all stakeholders. The source codes for the Mazu series ocean current and wave forecasting models have been open-sourced globally. The South China Sea Tsunami Advisory Centre (SCSTAC) is capable of releasing its initial advisory within 10 minutes, boasting world-leading speed and accuracy. China has long offered neighboring countries round-the-clock tsunami forecasting and warning services as well as personnel training. Its emergency remote sensing monitoring services for disasters have received favorable feedback from government authorities of Pacific island countries such as Kiribati and the Solomon Islands.
By advancing digital and intelligent technological transformation, China deepens maritime cooperation and provides solid support for capacity-building in developing countries. Jointly with African countries, China has released and launched the Xinghai Multi-scale Comprehensive Marine Dataset. It includes an online marine remote sensing analysis platform, remote sensing monitoring of the coastal zones of Africa and the Indian Ocean, and AI-based integrated four-dimensional chlorophyll datasets. It has also developed the 'Toolkit for Marine Solutions for Sustainable Development of Coastal Cities' to deliver convenient marine information services and efficient decision-making support for integrated governance to developing countries.
China advances practical maritime cooperation driven by 'small yet beautiful' projects. Leveraging its extensive network and institutional platforms of blue partnerships, China and Madagascar jointly established a sea level change observation station to carry out long-term, continuous and high-precision sea level monitoring in the South Indian Ocean region. The station has been officially incorporated into the UNESCO Global Sea Level Observing System (GLOSS), contributing to climate change responses. China has also joined forces with relevant countries and international organizations to launch the Blue Citizens Initiative. Together with Thailand, Indonesia, Cambodia and other countries, China has delivered marine classroom and nature education programs, and jointly built Blue Communities, effectively raising ocean literacy within coastal communities.
The ocean unites the world into a community where we all rise and fall together. To achieve the object of promoting 'the economic and social advancement of all peoples of the world', there is no reason for UNCLOS to remain stagnant and unchanging. Instead, it ought to embrace new wisdom, concepts, and approaches to ocean governance with a more open, inclusive and forward-looking stance. The international community needs to join hands to uphold multilateralism and international law, including UNCLOS.
UNCLOS provides a comprehensive legal framework to safeguard the overall interests of the international community. Together with other maritime treaties and agreements, as well as customary international law, it underpins the modern system of the law of the sea. Valuing this milestone achieved through joint efforts of the entire international community, China advocates squarely addressing the internal constraints and external challenges in the implementation of UNCLOS.
For instance, UNCLOS contains inherent limitations. It cannot cover all matters of the law of the sea, and lacks sufficient institutional provisions to address newly emerging ocean affairs, which undermines its enforcement outcomes. Its implementation is simultaneously hindered by multiple obstacles, such as the misinterpretation of its provisions and the abuse of its procedures. Meanwhile, unilateral moves further erode the legal order founded under UNCLOS and damage its solemnity and authority.
It demonstrates due respect for its negotiating history and spirit of compromise to view UNCLOS in an objective, holistic and dialectical manner. It is essential to calibrate its positioning within the modern legal order for the seas and oceans-without underestimating or overstating its value-so as to properly balance continuity and development in the law of the sea.
It represents the right approach to uphold UNCLOS by interpreting and applying it fully, accurately, and in good faith. Rights conferred by UNCLOS should be exercised in a reasonable manner, and obligations thereunder discharged in good faith. The object and purpose of UNCLOS must be safeguarded, its built-in balance preserved, and abusive practices-such as interpretive distortions, abuse of process, and jurisdictional overreach-opposed.
It provides viable solutions to address persistent difficulties and challenges in UNCLOS implementation and improve global ocean governance by jointly advancing China's Four Global Initiatives. In the pursuit of the Sustainable Development Goals, modern law of the sea and China's cultural ethos can resonate in values. The path forward lies in practicing true multilateralism, accelerating the delivery of tangible outcomes under these Initiatives, and fostering a more just and equitable system for global ocean governance so as to advance steadily toward a community with a shared future for mankind.
Against the accelerating once-in-a-century global transformation, the ocean should serve as a vital platform to build consensus and pursue shared development. All countries need to regard win-win cooperation as a priority, jointly sustain and deepen solidarity in maritime cooperation and governance, and devote greater wisdom and strength to building our shared blue homeland.
The author, Shu Zhenya, is a research fellow of the China Institute for Marine Affairs, Ministry of Natural Resources of China.

中国积极深入参与全球海洋治理体系的建设，持续支持并促进《公约》设立的三大重要机构——国际海洋法法庭、国际海底管理局和大陆架界限委员会的有效运作。中国不断推进现代海洋秩序的发展，积极参与《公约》执行协定的谈判，例如《关于执行1982年12月10日〈联合国海洋法公约〉第十一部分的协定》和《执行1982年12月10日〈联合国海洋法公约〉有关养护和管理跨界鱼类种群和高度洄游鱼类种群的规定的协定》。《国家管辖范围以外区域海洋生物多样性的养护和可持续利用协定》是19年谈判的成果。中国全程参与了相关进程，并于今年1月积极推动该协定生效，支持厦门申请作为该协定秘书处所在地，展现了大国担当。此外，中国还建设性地参与了深海矿产资源开发规章磋商等重要国际规则制定进程。

海洋是资源宝库和支撑未来发展的战略空间。中国始终将自身发展融入全球可持续发展框架，拓展蓝色伙伴关系，深度参与全球海洋治理，积极推动构建海洋命运共同体。多年来，中国采取积极措施保障航行自由和航行安全，维护国际航道畅通。中国尊重和维护各国根据国际法享有的航行和飞越自由，坚决反对以所谓'航行自由'为名损害他国主权和安全的行为。此外，中国不断提升海上搜救等海上保障服务能力，极大地促进了航行安全。

中国提供的海洋公共产品惠及所有利益攸关方。'妈祖'系列海流和海浪预报模型源代码已向全球开源。南海海啸预警中心能在10分钟内发布初始预警，速度和精度均居世界前列。中国长期为周边国家提供全天候的海啸预报预警服务和人员培训。其灾害应急遥感监测服务获得了基里巴斯、所罗门群岛等太平洋岛国政府部门的积极反馈。

通过推进数字化、智能化技术转型，中国深化海洋合作，为发展中国家能力建设提供坚实支撑。中国与非洲国家共同发布并启动了'星海'多尺度综合海洋数据集。该数据集包括在线海洋遥感分析平台、非洲和印度洋海岸带遥感监测以及基于人工智能的四维叶绿素综合数据集。中国还开发了'沿海城市可持续发展海洋解决方案工具包'，为发展中国家提供便捷的海洋信息服务和高效的综合治理决策支持。中国以'小而美'项目推动务实海洋合作。

依托广泛的蓝色伙伴关系网络和机构平台，中国与马达加斯加共同建立了海平面变化观测站，在南印度洋区域开展长期、连续、高精度的海平面监测。该站已正式纳入联合国教科文组织全球海平面观测系统，为应对气候变化作出贡献。中国还联合相关国家和国际组织发起'蓝色公民'倡议。中国与泰国、印度尼西亚、柬埔寨等国共同开展海洋课堂和自然教育项目，共建蓝色社区，有效提升了沿海社区的海洋素养。海洋将世界联结成一个休戚与共的共同体。

为了实现促进'世界各国人民的经济和社会进步'的目标，《公约》没有理由停滞不前。相反，它应以更加开放、包容和前瞻的姿态，吸纳海洋治理的新智慧、新理念和新方法。国际社会需要携手维护多边主义和国际法，包括《公约》。《公约》为维护国际社会的整体利益提供了全面的法律框架。它与其它海洋条约、协定以及习惯国际法一道，构成了现代海洋法体系的基础。

珍视这一国际社会共同努力取得的里程碑，中国主张正视《公约》实施中的内在制约和外部挑战。例如，《公约》存在固有局限性。它无法涵盖所有海洋法事项，且缺乏足够的制度规定来应对新出现的海洋事务，这削弱了其执行效果。其执行同时受到多种障碍的阻碍，例如对其条款的曲解和对其程序的滥用。同时，单边行动进一步侵蚀了《公约》所确立的法律秩序，损害了其严肃性和权威性。

客观、全面、辩证地看待《公约》，是对其谈判历史和妥协精神的应有尊重。必须校准其在现代海洋法律秩序中的定位——既不低估也不夸大其价值——从而妥善平衡海洋法的延续与发展。全面、准确、善意地解释和适用《公约》，是维护《公约》的正确途径。《公约》赋予的权利应合理行使，其项下的义务应善意履行。必须维护《公约》的目标和宗旨，保持其内在平衡，反对解释扭曲、程序滥用和管辖权过度扩张等滥用行为。

通过共同推进中国的'四大全球倡议'，可以为解决《公约》实施中持续存在的困难和挑战、改善全球海洋治理提供可行方案。在追求可持续发展目标的过程中，现代海洋法与中国文化精神可以产生价值共鸣。前进的道路在于践行真正的多边主义，加快落实这些倡议下的切实成果，并建立一个更加公正合理的全球海洋治理体系，从而稳步迈向人类命运共同体。在百年未有之大变局加速演进的背景下，海洋应成为凝聚共识、谋求共同发展的重要平台。各国需以合作共赢为重，共同维护和深化海洋合作与治理中的团结，为建设我们共同的蓝色家园贡献更多智慧和力量。

作者舒振亚，系自然资源部海洋发展战略研究所研究员。

articles.fullText:
(ECNS) -- "In the current moment, China's 15th Five-Year budget plan at the beginning of this year, is of actual fascination and concentration. I don't remember a five-year plan in many years that has received as much attention as this one," said Adam Tooze, director of the European Institute at Columbia University in the U.S., in a recent interview with China News Network.
Against the backdrop of global governance challenges, including energy shocks, supply chain restructuring, and the risk of technological decoupling, China entered its 15th Five-Year Plan period in 2026, with its policy priorities center on expanding domestic demand, driving industrial upgrading through innovation, and accelerating the green transition across sectors ranging from advanced manufacturing to new energy.
On the topic of China's positioning during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, international scholars believe that the key to understanding the plan lies in deciphering the evolution of China's planning vocabulary itself.
The dynamic innovation of China's governance
The 15th Five-Year Plan, which kicks off in 2026, places greater emphasis on innovation and highlights innovation-driven high-quality development. This reflects a deepening of China's development planning toward more targeted policy implementation and improved governance effectiveness.
In Tooze's view, the new five-year plan budget edited by the Chinese government reflects a continuity of its policy. He noted that this budget is not a simple extension of past practices, but rather an effort to continuously adjust the direction of planning and pursue planning innovation.
"This constant modification of governance within China is easily underestimated from the outside," Tooze added.
Tooze also made an intriguing observation that the Western understanding of China's five-year planning often fails to grasp the subtle difference between the Chinese terms "jihua" (plan) and "guihua" (programming).
He pointed out that in the first decade of this century, China's five-year planning terminology had already undergone a fundamental shift from "plan" to "programming". In his view, this shift essentially introduced a governance evaluation framework centered on a statistical matrix, moving closer to the deeper logic of "governance" itself.
"In my eyes, this is a clear, long-term blueprint for modern governance," Tooze said approvingly. "It is a refreshing antidote to the reality to replace the challenges," added him.
Tooze's observation was resonated by Yuen Yuen Ang, Alfred Chandler Chair professor of political economy at Johns Hopkins University in the U.S.. In her view, the profound depth of China’s evolution from "plan" to "programming" is striking. And to understand why this shift is so critical, she suggested, one must first look back at China's growth model of the past.
Ang noted that since the 1980s, integration into the global system, export orientation, consumer goods manufacturing, investment, and infrastructure have together formed the main engines of China's economic growth. Early five-year plans, if likened to driving, were like moving straight ahead with a clear direction, making adjustments every five years and continuing forward.
"Now why is the 15th Five-Year Plan even more important than the past five-year plans？Because it is grabbing onto the steering wheel with a steady hand and making a short turn. There is a diving document for China's structural transformation from simply pursuing growth in terms of the quantity of GDP towards high quality growth," said Ang.
She analyzed that high-quality development depends on cutting-edge innovation in specific fields.
China has historically been an important innovator, as she noted, and that is beyond doubt. She explained that over the past decades, China's innovative strengths have been more prominent in incremental innovation from "1 to 10" at the application level and in scaling from "10 to 100." The 15th Five-Year Plan, however, indicates that China now also aspires to excel in "0 to 1" innovation, which focuses more on basic research and original R&D.
"China's goal is not just to continue expanding the scale of its economy, but to become a '0 to 1' innovator. This is the broad context in which it's helpful to understand the significance of the 15th Five-Year Plan."
Dual engines: technological catch-up and consumption expansion in parallel
"If the 14th Five-Year Plan focused on catching up in cutting-edge technology, the 15th Five-Year Plan continues that technological catch-up while also making consumption promotion a core priority," Ang said of China’s positioning in the 15th Five-Year Plan period.
She emphasized that "0 to 1" innovation breakthroughs and "consumption expansion" are not parallel lines.
She pointed out that the goals of cutting-edge technology and consumption promotion are highly complementary, because China currently has the world's leading manufacturing capabilities. Whether simple consumer goods or advanced technology products, all can be produced at scale and at low cost. If China can continue to boost domestic consumption to absorb this production capacity, it will give rise to a genuine "China Opportunity 2.0." And this, she said, is the key juncture where the two major goals intersect.
She suggested that, to further expand domestic consumption, China should appropriately pivot some focus back to applied innovation, commercialization, and scaling, such as in e-commerce development.
"This is where China was very good at," she said, "and these are the kinds of innovations that produces the mass employment and participation in the labor market."
On this point, Tooze added that, beyond e-commerce, China's development of energy storage batteries is also a good example. As a representative of "10 to 100" scaling innovation, energy storage batteries are not only an extension of technological application but also create new scenarios for downstream consumption.
"Globally, this was an industry that didn't previously exists and its impact has been positive. It is one that transforms the possibilities of electrification, above all in poor countries, above all in sub-Saharan Africa. China should continue in this direction," Tooze said.
His ideas were echoed by Ang, who gave further projections that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, China will establish two pillars — "0 to 1" innovation and consumption promotion.
Looking ahead to the 16th Five-Year Plan, she believes more innovation scenarios involving broad consumer participation will emerge, which would further create jobs and ultimately release consumption momentum.

（中新网）——美国哥伦比亚大学欧洲研究所所长亚当·图泽近日在接受中新网采访时表示：“在当下这个时刻，中国今年年初开始的‘十五五’规划预算，确实令人着迷且值得关注。我不记得多年来有哪个五年计划像这次一样受到如此多的关注。”在全球治理面临能源冲击、供应链重组和技术脱钩风险的背景下，中国于2026年进入“十五五”规划期，其政策重点聚焦于扩大内需、以创新驱动产业升级，并加速从先进制造业到新能源等各领域的绿色转型。关于中国在“十五五”规划期的定位，国际学者认为，理解该规划的关键在于解读中国规划词汇本身的演变。中国治理的动态创新：2026年启动的“十五五”规划更加注重创新，并强调创新驱动的高质量发展。

这反映了中国发展规划正朝着更具针对性的政策实施和更高的治理效能深化。在图泽看来，中国政府编制的新五年规划预算体现了其政策的连续性。他指出，这一预算并非过去做法的简单延续，而是不断调整规划方向、追求规划创新的努力。“中国治理内部的这种持续调整，很容易被外界低估，”图泽补充道。图泽还提出了一个有趣的观察：西方对中国五年规划的理解，往往未能把握中文“计划”与“规划”这两个术语之间的微妙差异。

他指出，在本世纪头十年，中国五年规划的术语已经经历了从“计划”到“规划”的根本性转变。在他看来，这一转变本质上引入了一个以统计矩阵为核心的治理评估框架，更贴近“治理”本身的深层逻辑。“在我看来，这是一份清晰的现代治理长期蓝图，”图泽赞许地说。“对于现实挑战而言，这是一剂令人耳目一新的解药。”他补充道。图泽的观察得到了美国约翰霍普金斯大学政治经济学阿尔弗雷德·钱德里讲席教授洪源远的共鸣。

在她看来，中国从“计划”到“规划”的演变所蕴含的深刻内涵令人瞩目。她认为，要理解这一转变为何如此关键，首先必须回顾中国过去的增长模式。洪源远指出，自20世纪80年代以来，融入全球体系、出口导向、消费品制造、投资和基础设施共同构成了中国经济增长的主要引擎。早期的五年计划，如果比作驾驶，就像是沿着明确方向直线行驶，每五年调整一次，然后继续前进。“那么，为什么‘十五五’规划比以往的五年计划更为重要？因为它正稳稳地握住方向盘，进行一个短距离转弯。

这是一份指导中国从单纯追求GDP数量增长向高质量发展进行结构性转型的纲领性文件，”洪源远说。她分析道，高质量发展依赖于特定领域的尖端创新。她指出，中国历史上一直是一个重要的创新者，这一点毋庸置疑。她解释说，过去几十年，中国的创新优势更多体现在应用层面“从1到10”的增量创新以及“从10到100”的规模化创新上。然而，“十五五”规划表明，中国现在也渴望在“从0到1”的创新上取得卓越成就，这种创新更侧重于基础研究和原创性研发。“中国的目标不仅仅是继续扩大经济规模，而是要成为一个‘从0到1’的创新者。

这正是理解‘十五五’规划重要性的广阔背景。”
双引擎：技术追赶与消费扩张并行
“如果说‘十四五’规划侧重于尖端技术的追赶，那么‘十五五’规划在延续技术追赶的同时，也将促进消费作为核心优先事项，”洪源远在谈到中国在“十五五”规划期的定位时表示。她强调，“从0到1”的创新突破与“消费扩张”并非平行线。她指出，尖端技术目标和促进消费目标高度互补，因为中国目前拥有世界领先的制造能力。无论是简单的消费品还是先进的技术产品，都可以大规模、低成本地生产。如果中国能够持续提振国内消费以吸收这部分产能，就将催生真正的“中国机遇2.0”。她表示，这正是两大目标交汇的关键节点。

她建议，为进一步扩大国内消费，中国应适当将部分重心重新转向应用创新、商业化和规模化，例如在电子商务发展方面。“这是中国过去非常擅长的领域，”她说，“而且这类创新能够产生大规模就业和劳动力市场参与。”
在这一点上，图泽补充道，除了电子商务，中国储能电池的发展也是一个很好的例子。作为“从10到100”规模化创新的代表，储能电池不仅是技术应用的延伸，也为下游消费创造了新场景。“在全球范围内，这是一个以前不存在的行业，其影响是积极的。它改变了电气化的可能性，尤其是在贫穷国家，尤其是在撒哈拉以南非洲地区。

中国应该继续朝这个方向努力，”图泽说。他的观点得到了洪源远的赞同，她进一步预测，在“十五五”规划期间，中国将建立两大支柱——“从0到1”的创新和促进消费。展望“十六五”规划，她相信将会出现更多涉及广泛消费者参与的创新场景，这将进一步创造就业机会，并最终释放消费动力。

Flexible manufacturing
The SANY Heavy Machinery Kunshan Industrial Park in Kunshan, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province. 
In China's Yangtze River Delta region, industrial AI is evolving toward higher flexibility and autonomy.
In a textile factory in Taicang, Suzhou City in east China's Jiangsu Province, over 500 air-jet looms have been connected to a centralized AI system that continuously monitors yarn tension, insertion speed and motor temperature. Through digital twin modeling and real-time optimization of 128 process parameters, fabric weight deviation has been controlled within 1.2%, while order response speed has been improved by 40%. The factory has also used AI to optimize its sizing process, cutting steam consumption by 300 kilograms for every tonne of yarn produced.

The factory even supports "one-unit order," with customization rates reaching 75% for mini excavators.

According to China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), by the end of 2025, more than 30% of manufacturing enterprises with annual revenue of at least 20 million yuan (about $3 million) had adopted AI technologies. Industrial intelligent agents covered over 70% of business scenarios in pioneer-level smart factories, accumulating more than 6,000 vertical domain models.

The MIIT, together with six other departments, recently issued an action plan to promote coordinated development among large, medium-sized and small enterprises in the platform economy from 2026 to 2028.
The platform economy is a new form of economy built on internet platforms.
The plan emphasizes strengthening innovation, ecosystem coordination, and openness across these enterprises, while deepening the integration of the real economy and the digital economy. It calls for greater openness in technology and data sharing, and encourages platform enterprises to strengthen AI innovation, improve algorithm governance and promote algorithm transparency.
By 2028, China aims to significantly improve the level of coordinated development among platform enterprises, form a number of replicable models for collaborative innovation, and cultivate a group of leading firms specializing in niche manufacturing segments in the platform economy.

Leaders of political parties and governments from around the world have sent congratulatory messages to the Communist Party of China (CPC)'s 105th founding anniversary, praising China's development under the CPC and expressing support for closer ties with China.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, said the CPC has led China through numerous challenges, advanced socialism with Chinese characteristics and opened a brilliant new chapter in the history of the Chinese nation's development.
Indonesian President and Great Indonesia Movement Party General Chairman Prabowo Subianto said China has developed into an advanced, strong and distinctive country under the CPC's leadership, adding that the CPC's success in lifting people out of poverty and improving livelihoods serves as a model for his party.
Maldivian President and People's National Congress leader Mohamed Muizzu said the CPC had enabled China to lift hundreds of millions of people out of poverty and become a global economic power. He thanked China for supporting the Maldives' development and said deepening ties between the two parties was more important than ever amid a complex international environment.
Turkish President and Justice and Development Party leader Recep Tayyip Erdogan said China had achieved remarkable global development under the CPC's leadership. He praised the China-proposed initiatives for promoting global stability and prosperity and said his party hoped to strengthen exchanges with the CPC and deepen bilateral cooperation.
Mahmoud Abbas, president of Palestine and chairman of the Palestine Liberation Organization Executive Committee, praised China's achievements and thanked Beijing for its longstanding support for the Palestinian cause. He reaffirmed support for the one-China principle and China's sovereignty and territorial integrity.
Kenyan President and United Democratic Alliance leader William Ruto said CPC's achievements have prompted countries in the Global South to rethink approaches to national development and governance, while further strengthening Kenya's resolve to pursue a path of transformative growth.
Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko said the CPC has demonstrated an outstanding ability to address complex global challenges while maintaining political continuity and long-term stability. He said the four global initiatives proposed by China would strengthen international cooperation and promote a fairer world order.
Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic said the CPC had led China to rapid development over the past 105 years, with its resilience offering hope to those committed to peace, development and multilateralism. He said Serbia was proud of its ironclad friendship with China and supported implementing global initiatives proposed by China.
Nauruan President David Adeang said the CPC has played a vital role in China's transformation, prosperity and improvements in people's well-being over the past 105 years. He said Nauru would continue strengthening bilateral relations and expanding cooperation with China.
Malaysian Prime Minister and People's Justice Party President Anwar Ibrahim said the ideals that began in Shanghai more than a century ago have become a vivid reality for the Chinese nation. He said the CPC has drawn on China's rich civilization while carrying forward its cultural heritage.
Singaporean Prime Minister and People's Action Party Secretary-General Lawrence Wong said China's profound transformation over the past century stemmed from the CPC's people-centered governance philosophy. He said both parties shared commitments to serving the people and clean governance, and looked forward to expanding cooperation.
Vanuatu Prime Minister and Leaders Party President Jotham Napat said the CPC has maintained its vitality through strong leadership, resilience and commitment to the people, leading China through profound transformation while contributing to world peace and development.
Samoan Prime Minister and Samoa United in Faith Party leader Laʻauli Leuatea Schmidt praised China's 15th Five-Year Plan and said it would further promote the country's long-term stability and high-quality development under the CPC's leadership.

Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) celebrated the 29th anniversary of the city's return to China with a significant visit on Thursday by a Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) Navy fleet.
The fleet consists of guided-missile destroyer Nanning and guided-missile frigate Hengyang, along with ship-borne helicopters and marines. It sailed into HKSAR waters on Thursday morning for a five-day visit, featuring open-house events and cultural exchange activities.
The HKSAR government held a welcome ceremony for the fleet at the PLA Hong Kong Garrison's naval base on Stonecutters Island.
The fleet sailed into Victoria Harbour in column formation at around 7 a.m. local time, escorted by vessels from the HKSAR government fleet and the PLA Hong Kong Garrison, before mooring at approximately 10 a.m. Senior PLA Navy officers and the visiting fleet, alongside crew representatives, disembarked and received a warm welcome extended by officials from the offices of the Central People's Government in HKSAR, representatives of the PLA Hong Kong Garrison, local residents and young students.
People take photos in front of the guided-missile destroyer Nanning at Victoria Harbour in Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China, July 2, 2026. 
The opening ceremony kicked off with the playing of the national anthem, after which HKSAR Chief Executive John Lee delivered a welcoming address. The officials and representatives then boarded the naval vessels for a tour.
This marks the maiden Hong Kong call for both Nanning and Hengyang. The two naval ships will open to Hong Kong and Macao residents and students from Friday through Sunday, enabling compatriots to gain first-hand insight into advances in China's new-era national defense and military modernization.

香港特别行政区于2026年7月2日庆祝回归祖国29周年，中国人民解放军海军舰队到访，意义重大。香港特别行政区周四庆祝回归祖国29周年，中国人民解放军海军舰队到访。该舰队由导弹驱逐舰南宁舰和导弹护卫舰衡阳舰组成，并搭载舰载直升机和海军陆战队员。舰队于周四上午驶入香港特别行政区水域，进行为期五天的访问，期间将举办开放日和文化交流活动。香港特别行政区政府在昂船洲解放军驻港部队海军基地为舰队举行了欢迎仪式。舰队于早上7点左右以纵队队形驶入维多利亚港。

当地时间，由香港特别行政区政府船队和解放军驻港部队船只护航，约上午10时停泊。解放军海军高级军官及到访舰队，与船员代表一同下船，受到中央人民政府驻香港特别行政区办公室官员、解放军驻港部队代表、当地居民和青年学生的热烈欢迎。2026年7月2日，人们在香港特别行政区维多利亚港的导弹驱逐舰南宁舰前拍照。开幕式在奏国歌中开始，随后香港特别行政区行政长官李家超致欢迎辞。官员和代表随后登舰参观。这是南宁舰和衡阳舰首次访问香港。

这两艘军舰将于周五至周日向香港和澳门居民及学生开放，让同胞们亲身了解中国新时代国防和军队现代化的进展。
